text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps saved about 4 hours a week on CRM updates and follow-up emails.

**2. Quality beat speed.** Notes captured pricing objections and stakeholder names that reps used to forget by Friday.

**3. Consent matters.** Asking every buyer upfront took ten seconds and built trust. Two prospects declined, and we respected that.

**4. Managers coached differently.** Reviewing call summaries replaced ride-alongs for routine deals.

**5. Adoption was uneven.** Reps who got a short training session used it 3x more than those who didn't.

The biggest takeaway: the tool didn't change how we sell. It gave reps more time to do it.

What did your team learn from your pilot?
